status: adopted-pre-outcome-amendment; not active execution configuration until execution freeze
derivation: unit_total_checkpoint[k] = actual_initialization(unit) + post_initialization_increments[k]; actual_initialization is validated charged camera+continuation+visibility rays of the mandatory identical 16-spp initialization on both allocation and production streams

rules.identical_initialization: actual_initialization must be identical across all six policies for each scene/frame/replicate unit; a mismatch invalidates that unit as a retained correctness failure that blocks PASS and is never dropped
rules.initialization_bound: actual_initialization must be a positive int, at least initialization_lower_bound (one camera ray per mandatory camera sample) and no greater than initialization_upper_bound; a violation stops integration as a bound/envelope failure and never widens the schedule
rules.completion: dispatch complete paired requests only while actual cumulative charge is below the unit threshold; complete both streams and their paths; score the first committed pair reaching it; overshoot is at most maximum_integer_checkpoint_overshoot; never truncate
rules.accounting: never charge initialization_upper_bound as observed work, reset counters, or exclude pilots or initialization from actual charge
rules.disclosure: report each checkpoint as a post-initialization increment with nominal increment, per-unit actual_initialization, absolute nominal threshold, actual charge and overshoot
rules.analysis_keys: analysis checkpoint keys remain the increments 2^20, 2^22, 2^24, 2^26; totals differ by unit while within-unit paired comparisons stay at equal nominal totals
rules.unchanged: primary metric formula, thresholds, comparators, families and seeds are unchanged

validation: Arithmetic and synthetic rule checks only; selected-host native validation of actual_initialization identity and bounds remains pending
